Activate Organizational Changes
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/status/activate

Activates the saved configuration changes. To learn more, see Saving and Activating Changes in the ZIA Admin Portal.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
status
string

Possible values: [ACTIVE, PENDING, INPROGRESS]
